records.text: Owens said a third party relayed the unnamed surgeon's claim that his frangible-bullet suggestion occurred on a three-way call with Andrew Kolvet and Erika Kirk
records.speaker: Anonymous surgeon source (Ep w1oqQbR_bYs; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: I should also mention that the surgeon said, and again, this is through a third party person, so it's on direct line between me and the surgeon, that he absolutely did not violate HIPAA when he suggested, hey, maybe it's a frangible bullet, but rather that it was a three-way call with him and Andrew and Erika.

verification.notes: This is a third-party relay of an unnamed surgeon’s account of a private call. No call record, named surgeon confirmation, or recording was published, and the episode itself notes a conflict with Erika Kirk’s and Andrew Kolvet’s accounts. The call composition and frangible-bullet wording remain unverifiable.
